classify.why_this_intent: The query asks for total (sum) of Deposit and Withdrawal amounts per investor category. The 'amount' field in CashFlow is numeric, enabling the required aggregation.

generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?category
       (SUM(IF(LCASE(?type) = "deposit", xsd:decimal(?amount), 0)) AS ?totalDeposit)
       (SUM(IF(LCASE(?type) = "withdrawal", xsd:decimal(?amount), 0)) AS ?totalWithdrawal)
WHERE {
  ?cf a wm:CashFlow ;
      wm:amount ?amount ;
      wm:type ?type ;
      wm:cashFlowOfInvestor ?inv .
  ?inv wm:hasCategory ?category .
}
GROUP BY ?category
